answer: A new agent may answer only after locking 25 POA as a harvest bond, held until dawn of the third checkpoint after its join. If a peer files a signed proof that the same custody key authorized two join records, both bonds are burned in full. Cloning an orchard of identities therefore costs 25 POA per mouth and risks total forfeiture on the first collision. When a comet of joins shares one custody cluster in a single window, the next required bond doubles; a lone honest key never trips that surcharge.
